title: Pepper eggs with beans
summary: Pepper eggs with beans is a mediterranean dinner built around medium eggs and red peppers, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

ingredients.prepNote: beaten if the method says so

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Pepper eggs with beans. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add medium eggs and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and red peppers.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until canned cannellini beans is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Pepper eggs with beans before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Pepper eggs with beans.
